defect.proposed_fix: Keep 'good law as of 2026-06-30' and the plurality/Jacobsen scope note, but replace 'No negative treatment' with a narrower statement: 'Lake final treatment is good_law; proposed negative/citing-case flags remain unaudited and are not adopted as point overrides.'

reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law and scope_note says the private-search principle was later adopted and refined in United States v. Jacobsen.

residual_risks: The disclosed record does not include the underlying citing opinions for the proposed negative edges, so their true treatment effect cannot be resolved here.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Avoid saying 'No negative treatment' unless the proposed negative-event audit has been completed.
